discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 work runs from basic peptide discovery to drugs with huge clinical and societal impact. It has been recognized by the Lasker (2024), Breakthrough and Gairdner prizes, and the Nobel committee has recently favored physiology with clear translational payoff. Recent prizes went to mRNA, microRNA and Treg tolerance, so the metabolic hormone area has not been honored lately.
